timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This is the November 2020 Meteor Report for the Craferd Manor House Astronautical Society
Dafford. This month we identified 244 meters, the brightest of which was of magnitude minus
3.6. Spiradic meters, those not identified with a shower were the most prominent, the
most prominent shower being from the Leonids, where we identified 39 meters during the month.
We had 12 days where the weather prevented us from seeing any meters and you can see from the video
that many of the other days suffered from cloud. That said there are some spectacular fireballs and
meters this month and I encourage you to watch all the way through to the end. Our setup is
relatively simple. A single WattEC video camera connected to a PC running UFO analyzer detects
Meteor candidates. These are copied to a network attached storage device which has a web interface.
Society members access this cloud drive and delete any false positive detections. This way the
members can contribute whilst at home and share the burden of sifting through the potential meteors.
At the end of the month one member runs analysis of the meteors and these data are passed onto
the nematode group. The Meteor camera is located at our headquarters at Sutton at home,
a hardware, software and internet connection but all funded by the society and all members of
the society are encouraged to take part. The more people interested in contributing the more
cameras we can have. So if you are a member and want to take part please contact Jenny Smaclin.
The Craved Manorhouse Astronomical Society Dartford meet every Thursday currently via Zoom due to
the COVID-19 pandemic. Most evenings consist of a professional lecture by academic space scientists
or well-known and talented emitors followed by member observations and other society business.
If you'd like to take part please contact our secretary on secretary at CravedManorastro.com.
If you've enjoyed this video please leave a thumbs up. If you have a question please comment
and if you'd like to see more of these videos please subscribe.
